fact: The Ministry of National Education's planning, analysis and school map directorate held a validation workshop on 7 October 2025 in N'Djamena for the 2024-2025 school statistical yearbook; the document gives no release date for it.

INSEED set up, as a pilot, a data collection and analysis device on civil status events in N'Djamena and presented its results at a workshop on 27 May 2024 attended by ANATS, the city hall and UNICEF.
